```{r pw-setup, include=FALSE}
# rna_04_pathways_report.Rmd
# HTML report generated by rna_04.1_pathways.R via rmarkdown::render();
# uses the variables of that script (RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE, OUT_PREFIX...) and reads
# tables and figures from results/<RECEPTOR>/<CELL_LINE>/. Not run on its own.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,
                      fig.align="center", dpi=150)
library(dplyr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

fmt_tbl <- function(df, caption=NULL)
  df |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) |>
  kable(caption=caption) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)

res_dir <- here::here("results", RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE)
fig_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "tables")

load_csv <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path(tab_dir, f)
  if (file.exists(p)) read.csv(p, check.names=FALSE) else NULL
}
```

## ORA {.tabset}

### GO BP — Upregulated

```{r ora-go-up}
df <- load_csv("04_go_bp_upregulated.csv")
if (!is.null(df))
  df |> dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, Count) |>
    slice_head(n=10) |> fmt_tbl("ORA GO BP — Upregulated (top 10)")
```

```{r ora-go-up-fig, out.width="85%"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, "04_go_bp_upregulated.png"))
```
